name: Better Balloon
author: modChad
description: The hot-air balloon made for ponies: fly with WASD and Q/E at the Helm while looking around freely, drift on the breeze, lean over the side with Ctrl. A lower basket ponies can see out of, with its ropes rebuilt; passengers look over the rim and talk together as a group; ponies you carry in stay aboard, passengers wait while you fetch another, and followers who stop short of the ramp are helped in. Replaces Balloon Boarding.
